prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One fully NEW and reimagined StarNet game prop. Reference 1 is approved crate: exact finish/readability standard. Reference 2 is approved workstation: exact camera and craft. Reference 3 is approved bridge: world context. Use these solely as style references. Do not copy the crate or desk silhouette. South-facing overhead oblique station camera, perfectly straight-on in horizontal alignment, NO yaw, no isometric diagonals: horizontal long edges, vertical supports, symmetrical foreshortening, top planes visible at the same angle as workstation reference. Worn cool charcoal steel, broad readable panels, deep recesses, sparse purposeful brass/amber edge wear. Retain clear major parts at tiny game scale; no overly intricate micro-machinery, no arbitrary blue paint or bright chrome. Entire single prop isolated with generous margin and true transparent alpha background. No checkerboard, floor, room, text, other props, label or framing. Design a compact rolling supply trolley from first principles, a recognizably OPEN framework with gaps and two trays. Two tiles wide one deep; height approximately same as workstation; almost square total silhouette. Fresh construction: two bent tubular charcoal uprights, continuous rear push handle above an open deep top tray holding TWO broad plain capped supply canisters, a lower slatted shelf holding ONE inset graphite transit box, four understated squat wheels with two clearly visible at the near feet. Keep 30 percent of the body open negative space so it reads as a trolley and NOT a solid cabinet. Large clear tray rims, broad practical handles. New canisters may have dull brushed-steel caps for functional separation. No screen, hazard stripes, neon, paperwork or random colored cargo. Small number of easily readable parts.
